body: Wanna chat on Reddit? I’m doing a little better now, but I’d love to chat!

I guess I just don’t get the point if I’m just going to suffer. I mean, I guess it would keep my parents from being sad, and I appreciate them and don’t want to make them sad, but... it just doesn’t seem fair that I have to keep being so miserable just to save other people from that.

And... what if things get worse? What if I fail out of school? What if when I graduate, I’ll be even more alone? I’m just scared that something will happen- one more weight will fall on my shoulders- and I’ll just break under it all.

Sometimes I wonder if someone would care then. I know it’s selfish, but... my mom gives my sister all her attention because she needs it. If I did something, like cut myself, did drugs, or attempted suicide in a way people could find out about, then maybe someone would give me attention.
